blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Industries are broadly categorized based on Raw Material, Size, and Ownership.
The Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 established state control and public sector dominance in Indian industry.
The New Industrial Policy of 1991 introduced Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization (LPG reforms).
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) serve as critical drivers for employment and economic growth.
Industrial Corridors and government initiatives aim to strengthen infrastructure and boost manufacturing.

blocks.content: Industrial development refers to the growth of industries in a country.
It includes the establishment of factories, expansion of manufacturing activities, use of machines, and development of industrial infrastructure.
Industrial development is a key indicator of economic progress because it:
India started focusing seriously on industrial development after independence.
Industry refers to all economic activities related to:
In simple words, industry means converting raw materials into finished goods with the help of labour, machines and capital.
Industrial development increases production which increases GDP.

items: Reduction of Pressure on Agriculture: Industrial jobs reduce dependence on agriculture.

blocks.content: Industries promote development of backward areas.
Industrial goods increase exports and reduce imports.
Industries promote research, innovation and technology.
More income leads to better living standards.

Industrial development is essential for economic growth. With proper policies, infrastructure and investment,India can become a global industrial power.
